svg.aria-label: Iskariot — AI Systems Engineer. Animated schematics of the serving and agent stack.
svg.title: Iskariot — AI Systems Engineer
svg.desc: Animated schematic plates: stale-dom, compaction, fan-out, proven-math, harness, long-horizon, decision-drift, injection-gate, pii-membrane, tool-validation, sandbox, meta-agent. Illustrations of how these mechanisms behave — not benchmark results.
